analysis: MARKET REGIME: SPY uptrend intact (+1.5% vs SMA50, 20d slope +1.08%). Constructive backdrop but not a license to force deployment. EXISTING POSITION REVIEW: AMP (+4.3%) and MCO (+8.5%) are performing well; theses intact, hold. LMT (-2.90%) small loss — defense sector thesis still valid (geopolitical spend), within normal volatility, no thesis break. SYK (-0.74%) essentially flat; SMA50 slope +4.1% is encouraging, hold. IDXX (+0.18%) is a concern — essentially flat, lacks momentum. Not a thesis break, but a low-conviction hold consuming ~14% of equity; monitor closely and exit if it loses SMA50 or fundamentals deteriorate. Portfolio heat is very low (1.44%), which is healthy. PERFORMANCE CONTEXT: Profit factor 0.60x and Sortino -2.92 are sobering — they argue strongly against forcing trades to manufacture alpha. The bar for a new position must be high. CANDIDATE SCREEN: Most quality names are extended above SMA50 (ADBE +18%, RMD +12%, ACN +22%, PTC +19%) or carry sector overlap with existing positions (NOC duplicates LMT defense exposure). ADBE has earnings in 16 days — binary risk. CVNA and HOOD carry excessive debt and speculative valuation risk. ONE GENUINE SETUP: ROP (Roper Technologies) is a rare combination of Buffett-quality fundamentals (27.7% op margin, $2.3B FCF, 17x fwd earnings, software-centric compounder) at a technically acceptable entry — 48% of 52w range, strong SMA50 slope (+8.4%), confirmed uptrend, and +12.9% above SMA50 is within the acceptable threshold (<20%). Headroom constrains position to ~56 shares (~22.8% of equity). Risk is 1.1% of equity — disciplined. All other candidates either have sector overlap, are too extended, carry near-term earnings risk, or lack the quality/technical combination required. Recommending one focused trade; remaining cash (~$5K) held as buffer.

trades.entry_strategy: Buy at market or limit at $415; alternatively wait for any intraday pullback toward $410 before entry. Do not chase if price gaps above $425 before fill.

Revenue growth of 8.5% with high recurring revenue base. Analyst EPS revisions modestly positive (+1.8%). No near-term earnings risk (Oct 22). TECHNICAL: Confirmed uptrend, SMA50 slope +8.4% per month (strong and accelerating), price at 48% of 52w range (middle zone — not extended on absolute basis), +12.9% above SMA50 within the acceptable <20% threshold per rules. 52w range $313-$525 leaves meaningful upside runway to prior highs. Entry at 2.0x ATR stop ($19.94 risk/share) keeps total position risk at ~1.1% of equity. Position sized at 56 shares ($23,249, 22.8% of equity) constrained by available headroom.
trades.exit_plan: Primary stop: $395.57 (2.0x ATR, -4.8%). Thesis-break exits: (1) SMA50 slope turns negative for two consecutive weeks; (2) FCF guidance cut or margin compression in earnings report; (3) transformative debt-funded acquisition that changes the capital-light model. Time stop: reassess at 6 months if price has not made progress toward target. Intend to hold past 1-year mark for LTCG treatment if thesis remains intact. Trim 25-33% of position near $490 if reached quickly (within 3 months) to de-risk remainder into LTCG territory.
